text: Ayesha's daughter Saanvi starts reception next Tuesday. Ayesha is more nervous than Saanvi is, apparently. Text her that morning to see how drop-off went.
Connor and Kiara are picking up their new puppy on Saturday, a cocker spaniel they're calling Biscuit. Kiara has already bought three beds for it.
Mabel turns 80 in a fortnight. She's really into jigsaws at the moment, the big 1000-piece ones, and said her old magnifying lamp has finally died.
Leon's cat Pepper had surgery on her jaw yesterday. He sounded exhausted on the phone. I should check in with him tomorrow evening.
Picked up the cake for Sunday. Still need candles and a card.

Dawit graduates from Leeds on Thursday, a first in mechanical engineering. His parents are flying over from Addis for it. Send him a proper congratulations message the day after, once the ceremony chaos has died down.
Grace mentioned her son Malik has his driving test next Wednesday. Third attempt, and he's really anxious about it.
James says Ann is obsessed with sourdough lately. Could be a good angle for her birthday at the end of the month: a proper banneton or a nice Dutch oven.
Siobhan's party on Friday is cancelled; her dad's back in hospital. She's going to Cork tomorrow to be with him. Don't forget to message her over the weekend.
Yetunde's son got into the grammar school! She found out this morning and was nearly in tears. They're celebrating with a family dinner on Saturday.

Gintaras has a rescue greyhound now, Luna. Very shy, sleeps about twenty hours a day, and won't go near the stairs yet. She raced for four years before the trust took her in, and he says she still flinches at loud noises. He's completely besotted and has already bought her a fleece coat and a ridiculous memory foam bed.
Need to book the vet for the dog's booster before the end of next week.
Lunch with Tamar. Her twins finish primary school this summer and she's already dreading secondary school applications. She works part time at the library now and loves it.
Hadiza's little girl took her first steps on Monday. Hadiza sent a video. Absolutely adorable.
Ask Samir how his daughter's GCSE results went. They come out Thursday and he said she's been unbearable the week before.
Agnieszka's birthday is this Sunday. She's into houseplants and has been hinting about a monstera for months. Pick one up on Saturday and drop it round that afternoon.
Duc and his wife are going to Vietnam for three weeks over Christmas to see her grandmother. Their cat Mochi is staying with Duc's brother.
Colm said his mum's old terrier, Benny, had to be put to sleep at the weekend. She's taking it really badly. He's going round to hers every evening this week.
Anjali's son Aarav starts at nursery on the 3rd. She's going back to work a week after. Must remember to ask her how both went.

Keisha is training for the Bristol half marathon in three weeks. She runs every morning before work and has given up sugar for it. Mad. Her sister Yetunde is coming down to watch and they're going for a big breakfast afterwards. Keisha's worried about her knee, which went at mile ten on her long run last Sunday. Text her the day before the race.

Notes from Caitlin's: her brother Milan is graduating from his nursing degree next Friday and the whole family is driving down for it. She wants to get him something for his new flat too, maybe a decent coffee machine. He starts on the cardiac ward at St Thomas' the Monday after. Caitlin is so proud. Remember to send Milan a card before the ceremony.
Suzanne's cat Monty is fifteen tomorrow! She's getting him a tiny cake from the pet bakery. I'm going to send her a photo of the card I found.
Lior has his violin grade 5 exam on Tuesday morning. He's practised every day but his mum, Tamar, says he's still terrified. Text Tamar good luck for him the evening before.
Angela is turning 50 next month and absolutely does not want a party. Likes gin, gardening, and Agatha Christie. Noted.
Yosef and Anya are expecting their second in March! Anya has had awful morning sickness this time round. Yosef seemed delighted though.
Remind me to call Mabel on Wednesday. Her neighbour said she's had a fall and isn't letting anyone help.
Kiara is vegan now, which matters for Saturday's barbecue. Also allergic to cashews.
Grocery run tonight, then wrap presents. Collect the dry cleaning tomorrow before ten.

Connor says the puppy has already chewed through two charging cables, a skirting board and one of Kiara's trainers. He looks like he hasn't slept since the weekend. They're crate training now and Biscuit howls for the first hour every night, so they take turns sleeping on the sofa downstairs. Kiara thinks it'll settle in a week or two. Connor is less convinced. I should drop round some of the old puppy toys we never used.
Aarav's first week at nursery went fine in the end. Anjali was relieved. He's apparently mostly interested in the sandpit and the class guinea pig.
Samir's daughter got straight 9s in maths and science. Should send her a little something, maybe a book token.

Dinner with Keisha and her partner Malik. They've just adopted two kittens, Salt and Pepper, from the shelter on Elm Road. Malik works nights at the hospital, so Keisha does most of the feeding. They want me to come and meet the kittens next weekend.

Ann's birthday is Saturday the 14th. James is organising a surprise brunch the day before at that Turkish place on the high street, and he's roped in her sister Grace to get her there on time with some excuse about a dress fitting. Ann apparently hates surprises, so this could go either way. I said I'd bring the cake. She's into sourdough and all things fermented lately, so a kombucha kit might be a fun present.
Dr Ahmed, Yetunde's sister, has just been made a consultant. Yetunde says she's taking the whole family to Lisbon to celebrate in the spring.
Gintaras' greyhound needs a dental next Thursday under general anaesthetic. He's really worried because of her age. Check on him that afternoon.
Siobhan texted from Cork. Her dad's out of hospital and doing much better. She'll be back on Tuesday.
Note for future gifts: Leon collects vintage film cameras, Hadiza loves anything lavender-scented, and Duc is getting into bouldering.
Mrs Popescu next door said her granddaughter is sitting her eleven plus on Saturday. She's baking for her that morning, which seems to be the family tradition.
Colm's daughter Caitlin is doing her Leaving Cert mocks next week. He says she's barely sleeping. Ask him how she's coping on Friday.
Booked my own dentist appointment for the 28th. Tooth has been aching for a week.

Angela mentioned that her son James is going travelling in Peru for six months, flying out the day after his graduation. She's trying to be cool about it and very much failing. He's doing a stint volunteering at an animal sanctuary first, then hiking the Inca Trail with two friends from uni. She's already asked if I know anyone who's been, and I think Ann went a few years ago. Must put them in touch before he leaves.
Milan rang. He's thinking of getting a dog once he's settled into the new flat, probably a whippet. Wants my opinion on breeders.
Ayesha's husband, Yosef Kim, has his citizenship ceremony on Monday. She's planned a small lunch afterwards with both families. Don't forget to get him a card.

Duc's cat Mochi has been off her food for days and they think it might be her kidneys. Bloods are back Friday. Duc is trying to stay calm, but she's seventeen and he's had her since he was at uni, so he's pretty shaken. His wife is the one doing the vet runs because he can't face it. I'll ring him on Friday evening once they've heard.
Agnieszka loved the monstera. She's named it Gerald.
Tamar told me Lior is turning nine on the 22nd. He's into Lego Technic and dinosaurs, in that order. A Technic set would go down well apparently.
Must message Grace on Wednesday afternoon to ask how Malik's test went. If he passed, he's apparently taking her for a drive to the coast that weekend.

Catch-up with Suzanne. She's retiring from the council at Christmas after thirty-one years and wants to spend more time with her granddaughter, Mabel, who started school in September. Suzanne's daughter is moving back from Glasgow in the new year too, so it's a big few months. Retirement do is on the 19th. I'm bringing the photo album.
Malik passed! Grace says he's insufferable already. Bought him a keyring as a joke.
Remind me to send Hadiza the link to that lavender candle shop before her birthday next Friday.
Kiara and Connor are doing puppy training classes on Sunday mornings. Biscuit is apparently the worst in the class.
Walk the dog, sort the recycling, order a new lead.
Anya's due date is the 9th of March. Yosef has booked paternity leave starting the week before. They still haven't settled on names.
Dawit's sister Hadiza has a job interview at the BBC on Tuesday. He says she's really nervous. I should text her the night before to wish her luck, and then ask how it went on Wednesday.
Leon said Pepper is eating again, soft food only for another fortnight. Back to the vet on the 30th to check the stitches.

Long call with Anjali. Her father had a minor stroke last week and is in rehab at the Royal Free. She's splitting her time between the hospital, work, and getting Aarav to nursery, and she sounded worn out. Her brother Samir is flying in from Dubai on Saturday to help for a fortnight. I need to drop a meal round on Thursday evening and ask whether she wants me to do a nursery pickup next week.
Caitlin got her mock results back today. Much better than she feared. Colm is thrilled.

Saanvi lost her first tooth this morning and the tooth fairy apparently left a pound. Ayesha says it's now all she talks about. Ayesha has also signed her up for swimming lessons on Thursdays, which start next week, and Saanvi is already asking whether she'll get a badge. Her grandad Dawit is taking her to the first one because Ayesha is at work.
Gift ideas for Christmas: Mabel, bird feeder; Connor, a cookbook; Keisha, running socks; Gintaras, something for Luna.
Need to buy a birthday card for Siobhan, her party's been moved to the Saturday after next.
